title: Brazilian Toastie
description: A simple and delicious Brazilian-inspired toastie filled with vibrant cheese. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Butter one side of each slice of vibrant bread.
Place one slice of bread, butter-side down, in the pan.
Place one slice of Brazilian cheese on top of the bread in the pan.
Place the second slice of bread, butter-side up, on top of the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the toastie over and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
